Growing Open Technology Through an Open Community

The Web has grown through open technologies, open standards, and the participation of people around the world.

The Hyper Layering Community embraces this culture.

This community brings together people from different backgrounds to contribute technology and information to expand the ways Hyper Layering can be used, keeping it open to participation beyond any single company or organization.

Sharing Technology and How It Is Used

The community welcomes developers, businesses, universities and research institutions, local governments and public agencies, community organizations, and individual users of the technology.

What we share as a community goes beyond source code. We also share technologies, layers, data, services, use cases, and the ideas and insights gained through practical use.

Layers and approaches developed in one context can be adapted to another. The resulting outcomes and insights can then be shared back with the community. Through this ongoing exchange, we aim to broaden the use of Hyper Layering.

Putting Technology to Work in the Real World

The Hyper Layering Community’s activities extend beyond technological development.

A significant part of our work is using HLA and HLMap in areas such as disaster preparedness, local communities, urban planning, transportation, the environment, and research—creating the layers and services needed to address real-world problems.

Developers, information providers, and users participate autonomously to share technology, data, and experience.

Just as the Web has grown through open technologies and communities, we hope the Hyper Layering Community will be a place where many people participate, put the technology to use, and help the community grow together.
